name: rigger
description: Claude Code harness: engineering rules for every session and subagent, lessons capture, portable skills and agents, context and compaction guards, a side panel, and opt-in reply-format, Windows and WordPress packs

plugins.name: rigger-lessons
plugins.description: Capture lessons learned as you work, count the inbox at session start, curate them into rules

plugins.name: rigger-core
plugins.description: Skills (git workflow, subagent orchestration, tooling, e2e speed, UI traps), agents, commands (doctor, setup, coordinate, environments) and context, compaction and side-session guards

plugins.name: rigger-rules
plugins.description: Working rules (verification, tests, scope, git) injected at session start and into subagents, plus your own rules.d folder

plugins.name: rigger-talk
plugins.description: Reply-format rules for the main session: language, length and report order

plugins.name: rigger-wp
plugins.description: Opt-in, for WordPress developers: WordPress traps skill and the upstream WordPress agent skills behind a router

plugins.name: rigger-windows
plugins.description: Native Windows only: shell guards, red-run and drift tools, and Windows, PHP (Herd) and Node skills

plugins.name: rigger-panel
plugins.description: Panes beside the chat: session context and cost, your GitHub issues (read-only, via gh), the task list and the project's environments; /harness opens them
